card.name: Linking words in TB regimen descriptions
card.fires_on: Small linking words or punctuation (with, by, of, comma, the) inside tuberculosis treatment-regimen text, right before the rest of a drug combination or phase is named.

modes.label: Part of a regimen
modes.description: The word 'of' after 'as part' leading into a regimen of antituberculosis drugs.
modes.example: only in combination with bedaquiline and linezolid as part<< of>> the recommended dosage regimen

modes.label: Sequence of dosing phases
modes.description: 'by' or 'the' after 'followed' or 'Following', leading into the next phase of TB therapy.
modes.example: Bedaquiline 200 mg orally once daily for 8 weeks followed<< by>> 100 mg once daily for

modes.label: Drug list joiners
modes.description: A comma or 'with' within a list of combined TB drugs.
modes.example: combination regimen of Pretomanid Tablets, bedaquiline<<,>> and linezolid.
